candidates.prompt: Six-second photographic product-in-context demonstration. Preserve the exact black and teal Contoso Pro cordless drill from the supplied image, including its intact CONTOSO PRO wordmark, 20V battery, housing, chuck and long spiral twist drill bit. At a sunlit construction workbench, a worker wearing clear safety glasses holds the tool securely and drills one small straight hole into a pine board firmly clamped to the bench. The twist bit rotates on its own axis and enters the wood straight; it does not turn a screw. Both the worker's safety glasses and the whole drill, wordmark and battery remain visible. Show a convincing unfinished timber job site behind the bench, natural daylight and a small realistic amount of sawdust. Fixed side viewpoint, wide framing, no orbit, no close-up, no cropping of the tool. No floating tool, extra tool parts, bent bit, extra fingers, logos other than the supplied Contoso Pro marks, subtitles or soundtrack.
